name: Infosys
summary: Historical FY2025 evidence: 4.2% constant-currency growth exceeded the original outlook, but missed the January revision. Operating margin stayed within guidance. These are dated source comparisons, not a current recommendation.

findings.title: The guidance version changes the conclusion
findings.body: FY2025 constant-currency revenue growth was 4.2%. This exceeded the April 2024 range of 1–3%, but fell below the January 2025 revision of 4.5–5%.

findings.title: Annual margin stayed in the promised band
findings.body: FY2025 operating margin of 21.1% was within the original 20–22% band.

findings.title: Cash generation included tax refunds
findings.body: The annual report records FY2025 free cash flow of US$4.1 billion. Management separately reported US$3.5 billion excluding tax refunds; use the adjusted figure when comparing underlying cash conversion.

findings.title: The year ended with a sequential decline
findings.body: Q4 FY2025 revenue fell 3.5% in constant currency sequentially. Management attributed roughly two thirds of the drop to lower third-party costs, with the remainder linked to volume and seasonality.

commitments.statement: On 18 April 2024, management set FY2025 revenue growth guidance.
commitments.target: 1–3% year-on-year growth in constant currency; FY2025
commitments.observed: 4.2% year-on-year growth in constant currency; FY2025
commitments.reason: Exceeded the original upper bound by 1.2 percentage points. This comparison preserves the original target; it does not describe the later revision.

commitments.statement: On 16 January 2025, management raised its FY2025 revenue outlook.
commitments.target: 4.5–5% year-on-year growth in constant currency; FY2025
commitments.observed: 4.2% year-on-year growth in constant currency; FY2025
commitments.reason: The same annual metric finished 0.3 percentage points below the revised lower bound.

commitments.statement: On 18 April 2024, management guided to an annual margin range.
commitments.reason: The annual outcome was inside the stated band.

warnings: Historical example for the year ended 31 March 2025; sources checked on 11 November 2026. This is not the latest company result.
Extractive, manually verified evidence; no model-generated analysis. Guidance comparisons are arithmetic, not a management honesty score.
CC means constant currency. No organic-growth claim is made. Annual-report publication date was not independently established.
